title: Stable influence at parameter zero
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\\{−1,1\\}^n\\to\\mathbb R$, and let $i$ be a coordinate. The stable influence of $f$ at parameter $0$ and coordinate $i$ equals the square of the uniform Fourier coefficient of $f$ on the singleton subset $\\{i\\}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
